code_summary: Implements a custom cross-fitted epoch-selection mechanism that the menu cannot express. The menu can set n_checkpoints/checkpoint_combine, but it cannot replace the built-in rule that selects/combines checkpoints on the same validation users later used for scoring. This script captures every epoch's validation predictions from one FM training run, evaluates candidate rules (argmax single epoch vs average of top-k epochs by selection-half score) across user-held-out splits, picks the rule with best held-out primary, applies that fixed rule to produce final validation scores, and uses the trained model's normal test predictions unchanged because no per-epoch test vectors are exposed by existing primitives.
